task.title: Add validation preflight and risk-tier policy
task.summary: Add gateway preflight and risk-tier policy so low-risk mechanical/docs cleanup avoids late metadata blocks while high-risk work escalates to user semantic approval.

goal.outcome: Gateways can preflight required metadata/audits/proof before expensive validation and apply risk-tiered user escalation policy.
acceptance: Preflight reports missing upstream builds, audit evidence, task ids, content proof strategy, stale refs, and close/publication blockers before fresh validation handoff.
Risk tiers distinguish mechanical/docs cleanup, code-local, semantic-system, security/migration/publication, and destructive changes.
Low-risk fast path remains gateway-validated and records why user approval is not required beyond accepted semantics.
High-risk categories escalate to user approval before lower-layer promotion.
non_goals: Do not weaken implementation/task-close/publication content-proof requirements.
Do not bypass fresh validation where policy requires independence.
Do not consolidate public tool surface in this task.
verification: Add gateway/preflight tests for missing metadata, fast path eligibility, and escalation categories.
Run validation smoke tests and CodeWiki audits.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Preflight reports missing upstream builds, audit evidence, task ids, content proof strategy, stale refs, and close/publication blockers before fresh validation handoff.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Added buildValidationPreflight() in src/application/builds.ts plus preflight_only path in src/application/tools/validation.ts and adapter schema. Smoke tests assert missing audit/content/stale source metadata, publication readiness blockers, and no-report preflight behavior via direct preflight API.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Risk tiers distinguish mechanical/docs cleanup, code-local, semantic-system, security/migration/publication, and destructive changes.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: classifyValidationRisk() distinguishes mechanical-docs, code-local, semantic-system, security-migration-publication, and destructive tiers; validation-preflight smoke asserts mechanical, semantic-system, publication, and destructive paths.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Low-risk fast path remains gateway-validated and records why user approval is not required beyond accepted semantics.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Mechanical/docs preflight sets fast_path candidate/eligible only after audits and content proof are complete, and writeValidationReport passes mechanical validation with normal audit/isolation proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: High-risk categories escalate to user approval before lower-layer promotion.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: writeValidationReport now blocks pass verdicts lacking risk approval for high-risk tiers; publication smoke asserts missing approval blocks and approval:user passes with clean immutable proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Do not weaken implementation/task-close/publication content-proof requirements.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Existing isolation/commit-readiness requirements remain; publication readiness safe_to_push is enforced for publication profiles, and loop-isolation/builds smoke tests still pass.

closure_brief.user_intent: Continue roadmap with TASK-003: Add validation preflight and risk-tier policy.
implemented_changes: Added deterministic validation preflight with missing metadata/proof/ref/readiness reports.
Added risk-tier classification and approval gating for semantic-system, security/migration/publication, and destructive work.
Added read-only preflight_only validation tool path and adapter schema/guidance.
Added smoke coverage for missing metadata, low-risk fast path, high-risk escalation, and publication approval policy.
Updated validation gateway knowledge and validation skill docs, and rebuilt generated graph.
acceptance_evidence: Preflight reports required missing metadata/proof/ref/readiness categories in tests/smoke/validation-preflight.test.mjs.
Risk tiers and approval gates covered by tests/smoke/validation-preflight.test.mjs.
Existing validation proof constraints covered by tests/smoke/loop-isolation-policy.test.mjs and tests/smoke/builds.test.mjs.
non_goals_preserved: Did not weaken implementation/task-close/publication content-proof requirements.
Did not bypass fresh validation where policy requires independence.
Did not consolidate public tool surface; reused existing codewiki_validation with preflight_only.
remaining_risks: preflight_only live tool availability requires package reload after source update.

risks: Risk tier heuristics are deterministic string/path/profile classification; future tasks may refine source-owned policy tables if needed.
preflight_only is added to source schema; current running harness may need reload after package update to expose it as a live tool parameter.
